core.title: Kawneer Style Offset Door Pivot Set, Global TH1118

text.description_html:
Global TH1118 offset door pivot hinges, Kawneer styles.

The TH1118 offset pivots are used for both flush face frame installation and 1/8" recessed door applications. Kawneer door replace pivot hinges set.

Suitable for doors weighing up to 125 pounds. These Kawneer pivots are engineered for durability, style, and are easy to install.

Specifications: for Global TH1118 Kawneer Door Pivot Hinge

  • 3/4" offset pivots for Kawneer doors and frames
  • For flush door / frame and 1/8" recessed doors
  • Weather resistant
  • Aluminum case construction
  • Vertical adjustment 1/8"
  • Full race ball bearing and design, provides smooth operation on bottom pivot door portion
  • No sag, entire weight of doors rests on floor mounted pivot portion
  • Completely temper proof, yet easily removable, replacable in unlocked position
  • Handed - specify left handed or right handed when ordering
  • Global TH1118 Bottom Pivot Dimensions (PDF)
  • Global TH1118 Top Pivot Dimensions (PDF)

Also available: Kawneer Top Pivot Hinge and Kawneer Center Hung Bottom Pivot.

*Sold Individually (Top and Bottom Pivots).

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this pivot hinge:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
